applicationProfileUsageNote.en: [See DCAT] Use only the values PUBLIC and NON_PUBLIC from the code list, where PUBLIC stands for using the data service is unconditional, while NON_PUBLIC means using the service is subject to conditions. The conditions that only have the purpose of supporting the correct functioning of the data service (avoiding DDoS attacks, avoiding improper use, etc.), such as the application of authentication and authorization, are considered to be without conditions. However, if this leads to an assessment (e.g. is the organisation known, has a payment contract been concluded, etc.) prior to the granting of access, these are access-restricting conditions.
